tasks.name_en: Pick up the wine glass from the dining table
tasks.name_ja: 食卓からワイングラスを持ち上げる
instruction_variants: Pick up the wine glass from the dining table.
Grasp the designated glass and lift it clear of the table.
食卓にあるワイングラスを持ち上げてください。
tasks.notes: VirtualHome's official dataset README uses the exact illustrative program [Walk] <glass> (1), [Grab] <glass> (1) and explains that both actions target the same glass instance. This Task Atlas collection proposal narrows that generic simulator program to ycb_023_wine_glass. The VirtualHome class-name resource maps the noun glass to waterglass/wineglass scene names, but that alias list is not a taxonomy and does not identify a VirtualHome model or establish equivalence or compatibility with this YCB asset. Atlas graph walk: TaskInstance --acts_on--> ycb_023_wine_glass --instance_of--> concept:object_drinkware (exactly two existing Atlas relation edges). The dining-table resource is an external scene requirement. A VirtualHome avatar program is simulator evidence, not a physical-robot execution result.

tasks.name_en: Put the mug back on the dining table
tasks.name_ja: マグカップを食卓に戻す
instruction_variants: Put the mug back on the dining table.
Place the held mug upright on the clear table surface.
手に持っているマグカップを食卓に戻してください。
tasks.notes: VirtualHome's official simulation action documentation gives [PutBack] <glass> (1) <table> (1) as its two-object program form and defines PutBack as placing a held object on a nearby target; the resource alias file also maps the script noun mug to scene names including waterglass and wineglass. This Task Atlas record is a distinct sibling primitive from picking up a wine glass, proposed for the existing ycb_025_mug instance. Re-grounding from VirtualHome's generic object labels to the YCB mug is an Atlas design proposal only: the source publishes no corresponding model ID or object-equivalence/compatibility claim. The alias list is not a taxonomy. Atlas graph walk: TaskInstance --acts_on--> ycb_025_mug --instance_of--> concept:object_drinkware (exactly two existing Atlas relation edges). VirtualHome's avatar/action model does not demonstrate physical robot execution.

procedures.label: Approach, grasp, and lift the glass

steps.description: Locate the designated upright wine glass on the table.
Approach the glass without contacting nearby items.
Acquire a stable grasp while preserving the upright pose.
Lift the glass clear of the table surface.
Verify that the glass is held and remains upright.

requirements.reason: Proposed primary object for this Atlas task.

success_criteria: The wine glass is held securely and remains upright after being lifted clear of the table.
setup: Stage the proposed YCB wine glass upright on a clear marked table area; inspect it for damage before the trial.
reset: Return the glass to its marked table location and confirm it is stable and undamaged.
quality_checks: Confirm the glass was lifted clear, remained upright, and was not chipped or dropped.
failure_modes: Glass tilted or contacted nearby objects

procedures.label: Place the held mug back on the table

steps.description: Locate the clear marked destination area on the table.
Approach the destination while maintaining a secure hold on the mug.
Lower the mug onto the table in an upright pose.
Release only after the table supports the mug.
Verify the mug is upright and stable on the table.

requirements.reason: Proposed primary object for this Atlas task.

success_criteria: The mug is released upright and remains stable on the clear table area.
setup: Start with the proposed YCB mug held upright and a clear marked destination area on the table.
reset: Return the mug to the designated held start state using a separately verified safe setup.
quality_checks: Confirm the mug is supported by the table, upright, stable, and undamaged.
failure_modes: Mug tips or slides after release

draft_notes: This is an isolated, proposed VirtualHome reference bundle. It does not alter active YCB seed batches.

The two source-grounded sibling primitives are (1) walking to and grabbing the same generic glass instance, documented in the official dataset README, and (2) putting a held generic glass on a table with PutBack, documented in the official action specification. The latter is paired with the source alias mapping for mug only as context for a candidate mug re-grounding; the alias list is not an object taxonomy.

Each task ascends exactly two existing Atlas edges: TaskInstance --acts_on--> its primary YCB ObjectInstance --instance_of--> concept:object_drinkware. The tasks therefore join at the same existing ObjectClass while acting on distinct catalog objects, ycb_023_wine_glass and ycb_025_mug.

Cross-resource links are proposals from VirtualHome's generic labels to existing YCB objects. VirtualHome documentation does not supply the selected YCB model IDs, model equivalence, or asset compatibility; no such claim is made.

VirtualHome represents household activities as simulator programs and environment graphs; the source describes synthetic/simulator action semantics. No claim of population frequency or physical robot execution is supported. All timing fields are null because no Task Atlas collection was measured.
Source URLs point to the VirtualHome GitHub master branch as accessed 2026-09-25 and are not commit-pinned.
